Definition: a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting
BiblicalUsage: A plant in the prophets is usually Israel itself: the vineyard of the LORD is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are His pleasant plant — yet He looked for justice and found oppression. Job pictures the same hope in a tree cut down that will bud again through the scent of water.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God plants His people to bear fruit, and I hold that when the fruit fails, the fault is never in the planting but in us. Isaiah looked for justice from the pleasant plant and found oppression, and the cry went up to heaven.
